name: Neuron Collective Communication
notes: AllGather, ReduceScatter, AllReduce, AlltoAll, Permute. Intra-node (NeuronLink) vs inter-node (EFA). Trn2: 16 chips, 2D torus, 1024 GB/s/chip NeuronLink-v3, 3.2 Tbps EFA. LNC=2 default (4 ranks/chip). CC cores for collective orchestration. 15us RDMA latency.
